standard_prerequisites.name: For a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism there is a uniform bound N with R^p f_* vanishing on quasi-coherent modules in degrees p >= N, and the vanishing persists after base change, by the cohomology-of-schemes quasi-coherence lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the integer N used throughout the proof.

standard_prerequisites.name: The Grothendieck spectral sequence R^p f_* H^q(E) => R^{p+q} f_* E for the composition of derived functors
standard_prerequisites.use: Handles the bounded-below case of parts (1), (2), (3).

standard_prerequisites.name: The K-injective computation R Gamma(U, Rf_* E) = R Gamma(f^{-1}(U), E) on affine opens of the base, valid for the section functor by the nice-K-injective application lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the vanishing assertions (2) and (3) to cohomology of sections over affine opens.

standard_prerequisites.name: The truncation distinguished triangle tau_{<= -n-1} E -> E -> tau_{>= -n} E -> (tau_{<= -n-1} E)[1] in the derived category
standard_prerequisites.use: Extends part (1) from bounded-below to arbitrary E by reducing each cohomology degree to a bounded-below truncation.

core_obligations: Localize so S is quasi-compact and pick the uniform vanishing bound N from the cohomology-of-schemes lemma, valid also after base change (proof lines 679-685).
For E bounded below: combine the spectral sequence, quasi-coherence of each R^p f_* H^q(E), and the vanishing for p >= N to establish all three parts for such E (proof lines 687-696).

For parts (2) and (3): take an affine open U of S, use the base-change-persistent vanishing bound on f^{-1}(U) and the K-injective lemma for the section functor to get R Gamma(U, Rf_* E) = R Gamma(f^{-1}(U), E) vanishing in degrees >= N, then conclude for all affine U that H^m(Rf_* E) = 0 for m >= N; the same argument applied to the base-changed functor gives (3) (proof lines 698-712).

For part (1) in general: write E in the truncation distinguished triangle, note Rf_* tau_{<= -n-1} E has vanishing cohomology in degrees >= -n + N by (2), so each R^q f_* E equals R^q f_* tau_{>= -n} E for suitable n and the bounded-below result applies (proof lines 714-727).
proof_roadmap: Pick the uniform bound N and settle the bounded-below case with the spectral sequence (proof lines 679-696).
Prove the vanishing parts (2) and (3) on affine opens of the base via the K-injective section lemma (proof lines 698-712).
Prove quasi-coherence in general by reducing along the truncation triangle (proof lines 714-727).
